_readme: Corrections to the model's defect labels, from reading them.
Keyed 'DVSA category||DVSA description', exactly as they appear in
top_defects.parquet. Generate the review page with
'python -m motintel.review' — it prints the key for every row.
Each entry replaces only the fields it names; the rest stand as the
model wrote them. Committed on purpose: this file is the record of every
place a human disagreed with the model, and 'python -m motintel.enrich'
applies it before validating and writing, so the shipped mapping is
reproducible from the cache plus this file.
An override matching no defect stops the run rather than being ignored:
it means the wording it was written against has changed and the
"plain_english": "A brake pad or shoe is worn past its safe limit."
